fixedWording.creditDecisionBeforeOffers: Approval and rates come from the lender's soft check, not from me. The check returns the homeowner's actual offers, if there are any.
fixedWording.creditDecisionAfterOffers: The offers on screen are what the lender's check returned. Approval and rates come from the lender, so I can't say more about the homeowner's credit.
fixedWording.offTopic: I can only help with the financing for this project. For tax, legal or other questions, the homeowner can ask the right professional.
fixedWording.noOffers: No offers came back from this check. The lender will send the homeowner a notice explaining why, and I can't say more about it.

uiWording.ballparkNote: Estimate only: no credit check and no personal data. Share it to set expectations.
uiWording.softCheckAsk: Ask {homeowner} for permission to run a soft credit check. A soft check doesn't affect credit scores.
uiWording.consent: The homeowner has agreed to a soft credit check. It shows the offers the lender can make, if any.
uiWording.ballparkFinePrint: Estimates from {aprMin}%–{aprMax}% APR across the fixed-rate products you offer. The homeowner's rate depends on a credit review; this is not an offer of credit. Promo offers appear only with real offers, with their full terms.
uiWording.promoCliff: Pay off {payoff} within {months} months and the built-up interest isn't charged. If not, {cliff} of deferred interest is added.
uiWording.noOffersNotice: No offers came back from this check. The lender will send the homeowner a notice explaining why.
uiWording.noBudgetHint: No budget yet. Ask the homeowner: "What monthly amount would feel comfortable?"
